summary_rationale: TD Power Systems has a credible specialized AC generator franchise, deepening global OEM qualification (including a 10-year Siemens Energy build-to-print framework and 19 November 2026 fourth-plant ground-breaking for 125–325 MW two-pole machines), rising H1 FY2027 operating margins (20.02% standalone EBITDA), upgraded FY2027 revenue guidance (₹2,900–₹3,000 crore), and low funded debt. H1 FY2027 consolidated CFO inflected to ₹211.74 crore (~101% of H1 PAT). However, cyclical end-market history, extreme export/OEM concentration (90–92% H1 export inflows; single-OEM fourth-plant dependency without proprietary IP), U.S. tariff exposure and Turkey routing friction, a 35% six-month jump in standalone receivables to ₹956.31 crore, deliberate wind-down of legacy railway orders, undisclosed QIP proceeds deployment, and multi-year promoter stake reduction (34.27% to 26.51%) keep business quality conditional with active working-capital and capital-allocation watchpoints.
